The Tax Manager is responsible for providing support to the income tax accounting, income tax compliance, and indirect tax compliance functions of the organization. This position is an individual contributor role, without direct management of team members. The Tax Manager reports to the Tax Director and will work with the tax team, other accounting personnel, and worldwide offices to support accurate annual income tax filings and the quarterly and year-end income tax provisions. This is a hybrid-role, which will require travel to our office in Bohemia, NY, once or twice per week.
